title: Mai Shiranui (DOA6)
note: g04's own strikes (user 10-03: Luffee strikes like Mai Shiranui). The BVH come from Dead or Alive 6's RRPreview.rdb: ripper_tpose scripts/doa6/g2a_bvh.py --g1m <MAI_COS_004.g1m> --out _work/mocap/doa6_mai <MAI00000_MAI.g1a and the clips>. Clips picked from out/motion_sheets/doa6_mai_candidates (RoeMotionPacks.Sheet): A 01000 lunging jab, B 01110 mid elbow, C 01002 lunging straight, D 01040 high kick. inPlace: DOA's strikes step in 0.6-0.7 m - the step is taken out of the clip and the fight moves her along. Her stance too (user 10-03: "把不知火舞的架势也给 Luffee 当站架"): 00000 is the guard of g04 / g05 (FighterRig.strikePack roles replace the pack's). Every strike starts with the hips turned as the jab starts (face stance:mai_jab), as does the stance, so going from the stance into a strike and back does not twist her. 10-05 (user: "把不知火舞也加入进角色来"): she is a fighter herself (tools/doa/mai.json) - her game clips are segments here too: the shared CMN hurt / knockdown / lying clips Kasumi uses (00130, 00081, 00102), her entrances 07010_ENT (travels 4 m, 3.5 m off when the fight starts - not used) and 07110_ENT, her win 07020_WIN, and three specials (01004 flip and lunge, 01370 somersault in the air, 02002 as her super - only its last charge, from frame 196 (1.6 s): the whole 4.9 s combo backs off 1.5 m, stands, then charges 4.5 m, and with its straight-line travel taken out (in place) her body stood 3-3.75 m behind her place for 4 s, out of the picture), converted onto her skeleton by g2a_bvh.py.
